status: Current240-byte production transport from original native SEE/QDI/HRP output.

transport.message_framing: Exactly one complete 240-byte packet per message; reject truncation, oversized records and a version/bytes mismatch.

fields.name: flags
fields.meaning: Transport/source-presence flags; never OpenXR relation flags.

fields.name: sample_monotonic_ns
fields.meaning: Measured representable conversion of the actual gyro epoch; causal sample<=send required when CLOCK is present.

fields.name: gyro
fields.meaning: Real native Android-portrait input; no runtime-coordinate conversion or repeated bias subtraction.

fields.name: accel
fields.meaning: Real native Android-portrait input; no runtime-coordinate conversion or repeated bias subtraction.

fields.name: rotation_xyzw
fields.meaning: Raw vendor quaternion in x,y,z,w order; runtime mapping is separate.

fields.name: translation
fields.meaning: Raw vendor translation; presence is not physical position acceptance.

fields.name: pose_quality
fields.meaning: Raw vendor quality, not an Xr validity bit.

fields.name: tracking_state
fields.meaning: Raw vendor tracking state, widened from the source record u16.

fields.name: warning_flags
fields.meaning: Raw vendor warning bits, widened from the source record u16.

fields.name: pose_index
fields.meaning: Published pose-ring index; must be below 80 when RAW_POSE is present.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All three elements must be zero.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_IMU
known_flags.meaning: Real IMU input is present; required by the existing transport client.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_CLOCK
known_flags.meaning: A representable, causal measured BOOTTIME-to-MONOTONIC conversion is present; bracket is telemetry, not a50us gate.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_RAW_POSE
known_flags.meaning: A published native OEM192-byte slot passed finite copy checks and exact real gyro-epoch association. This is not pose-quality or physical tracking validation.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_CAMERA_SUBMITTED
known_flags.meaning: The producer recorded a camera submission; consumers must independently check freshness and pose validity.

oem_prediction_tail.coherence: All vectors come from the same selected published192-byte record as pose/time/state. DMA synchronization and copy checks detect observed interference. Original ring has no generation or formal atomic snapshot guarantee.
oem_prediction_tail.semantics: Raw OEM prediction coefficients, preserved verbatim in wire order. Interpretation and prediction timing belong to the explicit runtime consumer; this contract adds no prediction or coordinate transform.

existing_transport_client_checks: Require exactly240 bytes and current magic/version/bytes.
Require nonzero session_id, sequence, gyro and accel source epochs, known flags and real IMU presence.
Require finite real IMU vectors, zero reserved words and defined read status.
CLOCK requires nonzero sample_monotonic_ns<=send_monotonic_ns; clock bracket is measured telemetry.
RAW_POSE requires copied status, index<80 and pose epoch equal to real gyro epoch.
No fixed sample-age, accel-order, camera-age, bracket, quaternion-norm or whole-coefficient gate is part of transport integrity. Runtime maps each OEM field independently.
